package main

import (
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "os"

    "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/record"
    "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/runner/internal/exploration"
)

type template struct {
    Dimension exploration.Dimension `json:"dimension"`
    Ordinal uint64 `json:"ordinal"`
    SiteSHA256 record.SHA256 `json:"site_sha256"`
    Alternatives []record.SHA256 `json:"alternatives"`
    Selected uint32 `json:"selected"`
}
type input struct {
    Config exploration.SimulationConfig `json:"config"`
    Decisions []template `json:"decisions"`
    DivergedExecution *uint64 `json:"diverged_execution"`
    FailedExecution *uint64 `json:"failed_execution"`
}
type forcedView struct {
    Dimension exploration.Dimension `json:"dimension"`
    Ordinal uint64 `json:"ordinal"`
    Selected uint32 `json:"selected"`
    Identity record.SHA256 `json:"identity"`
}
type candidateView struct {
    SHA256 record.SHA256 `json:"sha256"`
    ParentSHA256 record.SHA256 `json:"parent_sha256"`
    Overrides []forcedView `json:"overrides"`
}
type roundView struct {
    Index uint64 `json:"index"`
    Candidates []candidateView `json:"candidates"`
    Summary exploration.SimulationSummary `json:"summary"`
}
func run() error {
    var request input
    decoder := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin)
    decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
    if err := decoder.Decode(&request); err != nil { return err }
    state, err := exploration.NewSimulation(request.Config)
    if err != nil { return err }
    views := []roundView{}
    for {
        round, ok := state.NextRound()
        if !ok { break }
        results := make([]exploration.SimulationResult, len(round.Candidates))
        candidates := make([]candidateView, len(round.Candidates))
        for index, candidate := range round.Candidates {
            decisions := make([]exploration.Decision, len(request.Decisions))
            for n, source := range request.Decisions {
                selected := source.Selected
                for _, forced := range candidate.Overrides {
                    if forced.Dimension == source.Dimension && forced.Ordinal == source.Ordinal { selected = forced.Selected }
                }
                var controls [][]byte
                if source.Dimension == exploration.DimensionRuntime {
                    controls = make([][]byte, len(source.Alternatives))
                    for rank := range controls { if uint32(rank) != selected { controls[rank] = []byte{byte(rank+1)} } }
                }
                decision, err := exploration.CanonicalControlledDecision(source.Dimension, source.Ordinal, source.SiteSHA256, source.Alternatives, controls, selected)
                if err != nil { return err }
                decisions[n] = decision
            }
            ordinal := state.LogicalExecutions+uint64(index)
            failed := request.FailedExecution != nil && *request.FailedExecution == ordinal
            failure := record.SHA256("")
            if failed { failure = record.HashBytes([]byte("controller-failure")) }
            results[index] = exploration.SimulationResult{ CandidateSHA256:candidate.SHA256, OutcomeSHA256:record.HashBytes([]byte("controller-outcome")), Failed:failed, FailureSHA256:failure, Diverged:request.DivergedExecution != nil && *request.DivergedExecution == ordinal, Decisions:decisions }
            overrides := make([]forcedView, len(candidate.Overrides))
            for n, forced := range candidate.Overrides { overrides[n] = forcedView{forced.Dimension,forced.Ordinal,forced.Selected,forced.Identity} }
            candidates[index] = candidateView{candidate.SHA256,candidate.ParentSHA256,overrides}
        }
        next, segment, err := exploration.CommitSimulationRound(state, round, results)
        if err != nil { return err }
        replayed, err := exploration.SimulationReplaySegment(state, segment)
        if err != nil { return err }
        expected, err := json.Marshal(next)
        if err != nil { return err }
        actual, err := json.Marshal(replayed)
        if err != nil { return err }
        if string(expected) != string(actual) { return fmt.Errorf("Go simulation segment replay differs") }
        views = append(views, roundView{round.Index,candidates,next.Summary()})
        state = next
    }
    return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"schema":"gomad.simulation-controller-corpus/v1","view":views})
}
func main() {
    if err := run(); err != nil { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,err); os.Exit(2) }
}
